cards.card_text: Then comes a line Asaph sings more than once, so lean in: “Restore us, O God, and cause Your face to shine upon us…” Friend, I spent YEARS in the back of a dark junk drawer, so “shine upon us” hits me RIGHT here.
cards.verse_text: Restore us, O God, and cause Your face to shine upon us, that we may be saved.

cards.card_text: And here's that line again, now calling Him the God of Hosts: “Restore us, O God of Hosts, and cause Your face to shine upon us, that we may be saved.”
cards.verse_text: Restore us, O God of Hosts, and cause Your face to shine upon us, that we may be saved.

cards.card_text: Asaph ends the song with that line again, and this time he calls on the LORD God of Hosts: “Restore us, O LORD God of Hosts; cause Your face to shine upon us, that we may be saved.”
cards.verse_text: Restore us, O LORD God of Hosts; cause Your face to shine upon us, that we may be saved.
